_note: Simplified 'Kid mode' steps for early readers (5-10). Keyed by lesson title, normalised to lowercase. course.html overlays these on the full lesson when Kid mode is on, and the Read-to-me button reads them aloud. Add a lesson by copying a block below and keeping steps short (aim for <= 8 words).

traffic light simulation.intro: We build a tiny traffic light that blinks all by itself.

steps.text: We make a tiny traffic light.
Get your board, 3 lights, and wires.
Push the red, yellow, and green lights in.
Add one little resistor to each light. It keeps them safe.
Join the wires: red to 13, yellow to 12, green to 11.
Plug the board into the computer.
Copy our code. Press the arrow to send it.
Watch! Red, then green, then yellow, again and again.
A light not on? Turn it around and try again.
You made a real traffic light. Well done!

prompting power.intro: We learn the secret to getting great answers from an AI.

steps.text: We learn to ask an AI smart questions.
Open ChatGPT with a grown-up.
Type: Tell me about dogs. Read the answer.
A bit boring, right? It is too fuzzy.
Learn the magic recipe: Role, Task, Detail, Format.
Try: You are a vet. Tell a kid 3 fun dog facts.
Wow, a much better answer!
Now pick your own topic and ask the smart way.
Add one more rule to make it even better.
Save your best question on a Recipe Card.
You can talk to an AI like a pro now!
